The apartment is well located in the Old Town, ten minutes walk from bus and train stops. Plenty of bars and restaurants in the area. The Juliet balconies were handy for ventilation. We really enjoyed our stay. Many visitor attractions are within walking distance. There is a lift.Didn't bother us, but there was noise from the street. Might be more intrusive in the summer if you sleep with the windows open.The kitchen has a large fridge freezer and we were impressed by the 4 ring induction hob. There is no oven, but the microwave was easy to use. Pans lacked lids.The double bedroom was reasonably sized and had generous space for clothes. Unfortunately we found the bed to be wobbly and the mattress a bit soft. The blind was very thin so it was never dark due to street lights and sun in the morning.There was plenty of hot water and soap, shampoo and shower gel was provided. The bathroom is adequate but would benefit from a few additional features such as a small bin, soap dish, variable height shower head.We had a couple of issues with things not working. Staff were very responsive and someone called round within the hour.The check-in procedure online giving access to an electronic key seems a good idea in principle but we found it difficult. Buffering, not progressing to next page, not indicating which field the answer wasn't accepted. We also got a message saying that we would have access a little earlier than 16:00. Unfortunately the electronic lock didn't get the message. Checkout was smooth.Overall, this well located apartment represents good value for money. We enjoyed our stay and would consider it again.

We had a wonderful and truly unforgettable vacation at the villa. There were 11 of us, and everyone was comfortably accommodated: the beds are separate, and almost every room has its own private bathroom with a shower and toilet.There is a small detail — the hot water is enough for everyone as long as showers are kept fairly short ??March is still quite cool, so for a comfortable sleep we asked for extra blankets. The hosts responded immediately to our request, provided everything we needed, and everyone was happy. There are also heaters in every room.The kitchen is very well equipped — it has everything you might need and even more. There are two washing machines, a dryer, and a separate sink for washing shoes, which is very convenient.There is only one hairdryer, so we kept it on a table in the hallway for everyone to use.The villa has several terraces with tables in different areas, which is perfect for enjoying meals in the sun both in the morning and in the evening.The sea is just a two-minute walk away, and a Mercadona supermarket is located 350 meters away.Everything was wonderful, and communication with the hosts was immediate and very pleasant.We highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable seaside vacation.Thank you!

Vorweg die Wohnung selber ist schön und die Lage einwandfrei. Das war es auch schon. Wir waren 2 Monate dort. Bereits nach vier Tagen hatten wir in einer Regenpause ein Fenster zum lüften geöffnet. Schon kamen mehrere SMS der Agentur. Ein Spion des Hauses hatte die Agentur angerufen das Wasser in Wohnung eindringt und der Laminatboden wohl beschädigt sei. Die Agentue hat den Eigentümer verständigt. Diese wieder die Agentur. Am nächsten Tage sendet diese eine Kontrollperson in das Apartment. Die totale Überwachung, kein gutes Gefühl. Drei Wochen später kamen noch einmal drei Personen und wollten zu dem Thema wissen ob alles in Ordnung sei. Natürlich nicht. Zwei Wochen vor dem Ende noch eine Überwachung. Ein Gerät in der Steckdose unten am Boden hatten wir gezogen. Danach gleich wieder eine SMS ob das Gerät vorhanden sei. Angeblich soll dieses für Geräusch und Umweltbelastung sein. Da es mit Wlan verbunden ist, scheint es ähnlich eine weitere Überwachung zu sein. Die Wohnung hinterläßt ein ungutes Gefühl mal abgesehen von Baulärm aus der Anlage sowie hinter der Anlage.

Dear Denise, we are very sorry to receive this review. Our service is always based on providing the best possible experience and ensuring our guests' stay in the best way we can. We sincerely regret that your arrival was not as smooth as you expected, and we would like to clarify that your stay took place during Holy Week in Malaga, one of the city's most important events, which attracts tens of thousands of people and involves road closures, changes to access routes, and large crowds in the streets, especially in the historic center. These circumstances, although generally expected, can vary each day depending on the procession routes established by the brotherhoods and local authorities. Sometimes, even we, as residents of Malaga, cannot get into our own homes, having to wait for the local authorities to reopen the streets or access points. We understand that this situation may have been inconvenient, but it is an extraordinary event beyond our direct control. Regarding the assistance provided, we are sorry if it was not perceived as sufficient. Our team tried to accommodate your request to the best of our ability. However, understandably, it's not always possible to have real-time information on all the routes and specific road closures for each procession. Even though they have a set average schedule, there can be stops and delays between brotherhoods, resulting in a longer wait to access the apartments. You mentioned that we should have offered you compensation, which is certainly not appropriate, as it's like arriving in Venice during Carnival and not being able to access the streets near your accommodation. We always advise people to be calm and patient during Holy Week, as it's a nationwide event, particularly pronounced in southern Spain. Sincerely,Booking DepartmentDel Parque Flats

Die Ferienwohnung ist sehr zentral gelegen, sodass viele Sehenswürdigkeiten fußläufig erreichbar sind. Dieser Punkt ist definitiv positiv hervorzuheben.Leider befindet sich die Wohnung selbst in einem stark abgewohnten Zustand. Es gab lose Sockelleisten, Flecken an den Wänden, fehlende beziehungsweise defekte Kleiderbügel sowie verschimmelte Dichtungen im Badezimmer. Zusätzlich funktionierten die Jalousien im Schlafzimmer nicht, weshalb dieser Raum für uns nicht zum Schlafen geeignet war.Der nächtliche Lärmpegel war extrem hoch. Trotz geschlossener Fenster waren sowohl Geräusche von der Straße als auch aus den darüber- und darunterliegenden Etagen sehr laut zu hören. Wir sind das Leben in einer Großstadt gewohnt, empfanden die Situation hier jedoch als deutlich schlimmer.Unverständlich fanden wir außerdem die erhobene Gebühr für die Grundreinigung. Trotz dieser zusätzlichen Kosten wurden wir in der Wohnung explizit darauf hingewiesen, den Müll selbstständig zu entsorgen – und zwar drei Straßen weiter. Wenn eine Gebühr für die Grundreinigung verlangt wird, sollte dieser Service aus unserer Sicht auch vollständig inkludiert sein.Ebenfalls störend war der Umgang mit meiner Mobilfunknummer. Diese wurde ausschließlich für Notfälle angegeben, dennoch erhielten wir nahezu täglich WhatsApp-Nachrichten. Die gleichen Inhalte wurden zusätzlich per E-Mail und über Booking versendet. Diese permanente Kommunikation empfanden wir als belastend und eher arbeitsähnlich als erholsam.Insgesamt entsprach der Aufenthalt leider nicht unseren Erwartungen und wir können die Unterkunft in diesem Zustand nicht weiterempfehlen.

Dear Denise, we are very sorry to receive this review. Our service is always based on providing the best possible experience and ensuring our guests' stay in the best way we can. We sincerely regret that your arrival was not as smooth as you expected, and we would like to clarify that your stay took place during Holy Week in Malaga, one of the city's most important events, which attracts tens of thousands of people and involves road closures, changes to access routes, and large crowds in the streets, especially in the historic center. These circumstances, although generally expected, can vary each day depending on the procession routes established by the brotherhoods and local authorities. Sometimes, even we, as residents of Malaga, cannot get into our own homes, having to wait for the local authorities to reopen the streets or access points. We understand that this situation may have been inconvenient, but it is an extraordinary event beyond our direct control. Regarding the assistance provided, we are sorry if it was not perceived as sufficient. Our team tried to accommodate your request to the best of our ability. However, understandably, it's not always possible to have real-time information on all the routes and specific road closures for each procession. Even though they have a set average schedule, there can be stops and delays between brotherhoods, resulting in a longer wait to access the apartments. You mentioned that we should have offered you compensation, which is certainly not appropriate, as it's like arriving in Venice during Carnival and not being able to access the streets near your accommodation. We always advise people to be calm and patient during Holy Week, as it's a nationwide event, particularly pronounced in southern Spain. Sincerely,Booking DepartmentDel Parque Flats

Quanto ao forno, é verdade que não está a funcionar e estamos a tratar da reparação. Por esse motivo, removemos esta informação da descrição do imóvel e, ao verificar, verá que não está incluído. No entanto, entendemos que o facto de o eletrodoméstico estar avariado possa ter causado confusão. Ficámos surpreendidos com a menção à reserva de lugar de estacionamento. The check-in process was unfortunately very complicated and ended up taking us almost two hours. There were two key lockers, one digital and one manual. We didn't realize the digital locker needed to be activated, so we assumed it was simply a card reader. We sent photos and videos showing that we were trying to open the manual locker, but instead of telling us we were using the wrong one, the support team kept insisting that we weren't opening it correctly. It was a very stressful experience, and we found the assistance to be quite unhelpful. This all happened between 21:20 and 23:20, after a long day of traveling, and we hadn't even had dinner yet. Having to spend two hours trying to access the apartment made the experience even more frustrating. Once an agent arrived and explained that the key locker was digital and showed us how to activate it, everything worked immediately. It's unfortunate that such a simple issue turned into such a frustrating experience because of the lack of clear guidance from the support team. On a positive note, the apartment itself was very nice, and we enjoyed our stay once we were finally able to get inside.

Als wir ankamen, war das Zimmer auf dem ersten Blick ganz gut. Nachdem wir jedoch unsere Sachen ablegten und uns genauer die Wohnung anschauten, merkten wir, dass es überall in der Wohnung Flecken gab. Die Decke, Wände, Boden, Kissenbezüge, Leintücher des Bettes, Geschirr, Fernseher, wirklich alles war befleckt. Der Boden fing an gewissen stellen an zu zerfallen, aufgrund von Schimmel die dich wegen Feuchtigkeit ansammelte. Auf dem Boden waren Haufenweise Ameisen die von der Küche bis zum Bett gingen und ebenso zahllose Mücken. I really enjoyed my stay in this apartment. Its greatest advantage is its excellent location: it is ideally situated within walking distance of Malaga city center. I was able to walk to Calle Larios, visit the main tourist attractions, restaurants, and shops, and fully enjoy the city’s atmosphere without needing to use public transportation.The apartment was comfortable, clean, and pleasant, which made my stay even more enjoyable. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to discover Malaga under the best possible conditions. A few small improvements could make the stay even more enjoyable. It would be appreciated if laundry detergent were provided for the washing machine, along with an adequate supply of shampoo and shower gel instead of very small bottles.During my previous stays in apartments in different countries, I have often found basic essentials such as laundry detergent, fabric softener, cleaning products, an air freshener, and sometimes a fabric disinfectant spray. These thoughtful touches make a real difference to guests’ comfort.It would also be helpful to provide a few extra trash bags so that used ones can be easily replaced during the stay. These are small details that significantly enhance the overall guest experience.Overall, these suggestions are simply intended to make an already very enjoyable experience even better.
